verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v1: hal min sabīli ʾilā salmā biyabrīni tawqu rtiḥālī ʾilayhā kāna yabrīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v2: muʿadhdhabu l-qalbi min ladhʿi ṣ-ṣabābati bal nāru l-biʿādi ʿalā l-ʾaḥshāʾi takwīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v3: kaʾanna shabḥiyā malqūṭu l-mafāwizi ʾaw qad ṣāra munʿadimā min baʿdi takwīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v4: wal-ḥubbu kam yudhhilu l-ʿaqla s-salīma kamā bintu th-thamānīna bal ʾaḥlā wayashfīnī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v5: kam yaʿtarī l-ḥubbu billadhāti maʿ ʾalami lakin yubārīhi ʾarbābu l-mayādīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v6: kam ghīḍa baḥru wakam jība l-barārī lahu lil-hi kam ghurribat ʾarbābu tazyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v7: dharnī ʾayā ʿādhilī bil-ḥaqqi munshariḥā ʿadāka ḥālī fakun talḥā ʾilā ḥīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v8: ʾabṭaʾata yā lāʾimī naṣīḥata walaqad ṣaḥaftuhā baʿda ʾilḥāḥi wa takhmīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v9: ʾinnī l-mutayyamu fī l-ʿahdi l-qadīmi falā talum bimithliyā fī ʾaḥwāli taḥnīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v11: ʾinna stimāʿī ḥamāma l-ʾayki ʾarbaḥu min samāʿi ʿadhlika ʾin jādat bitarnīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v12: khalli s-sabīla ʿani l-ʾaḥbābi munṣarifā ʾin lam tasir fātrukan man sāra lil-bīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v13: yā man yarūḥu wayaghdū bir-raḥīli waqad shuddat maṭāyāhu min salmā biyabrīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v14: ʾin zāda himmataka l-ʿalyāʾa shawquka min salmā faballigh salāmī khayra maʾamūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v15: faqul lahā ʾanā ʾilfu ṣirtu muʿtazilā ʿani l-majāmiʿi fī ʾawṣāfi maftūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v16: ʾinnī ʾuʿānī biʾashwāqi bilā malali qalbī yuṭāwiʿunī fī kulli maʾadhūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v17: waʾinna nāra l-jawā taqḍī l-fuʾāda kamā taqḍī l-ḥawāyā bisafʿi dūna tashyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v18: lā ʾastarīḥu kaʾanna l-jaʾashi ṣāḥi bihi summu l-ʾafāʿī wasummu lith-thaʿābīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v19: mā ḥubbu salmā walaylā mayyati thumma suʿ dā wasuʿāda waḥubbī ghayru maknūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v20: walā mawāʿida turʿā lā l-ʿuhūdu walā dhikra l-ʾaḥibbahi ẓahra l-ghaybi bid-dīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v21: ṣarrif ʿinānaka ʿan salmā wajāratihā la taṭmaʿan lidhawāti d-dalli wal-ʿīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v22: waʿuj ʾilā ḥaythu man turʿā l-ʿuhūdu bihi kadhāka mīthāqunā billaṭfi wallīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v23: wahuwa maḥaṭṭu r-rijāli l-wāfidīni waman ʾūlū l-ḥawāʾiji min ʾufqi wamin bīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v24: baytu l-wilāyati miṣbāḥu ẓ-ẓalāmi wamif tāḥu l-kunūzi wakhatmu l-kulli lil-ḥīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v25: shamsu l-maʿārifi tāju l-ʿārifīna waman yaḥwī l-faḍāʾila najlu ṭaha yāsīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v26: khalīfatu l-khayri wal-mukhtāri min muḍari sirru s-sarīrati sulṭānu s-salāṭīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v27: raʾīsu ʾahli l-hudā wal-barru farraqahum shaykhu l-mashāʾikhi fī l-ʾislāmi wad-dīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v28: ʾabū l-ʿabāsi ʾabū l-fayḍi lladhī baharat ʾāyātuhu kulla ʿaqli dhāka yughnīnī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v29: quṭbu l-wujūdi lladhī ʾabdā wilāyatahu rabbī wāʾādamu bayna l-māʾi wiṭ-ṭīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v30: wal-ghawthu wal-barzakhu l-maktūmu ʿāliyā ʾaq ṭābi l-ʾilahi bilā raybi watamyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v31: shaykhī t-tijānī lladhī shāʿat ṭarīqatuhu bayna l-bariyyati burhānu l-barāhīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v32: ṭarīqatu l-ḥaqqi qad tasrī s-sarāʾiru min ʿayni l-mashāribi fī ḥifẓi wataḥṣīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v33: ḥāzat bimajmūʿi ʾasrāri l-ʿajāʾibi wal- gharāʾibi l-ghurri fī ghāyāti taḥsīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v34: yā man yarūmu biwaṣfi kāna munfaridā wal-ḥālu yughnīka ʿan tawkīdi tabyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v35: qad ʾaflaḥa l-muʾuminūna l-mumsikūna bihā mannā mina llāhi fī yusri watamkīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v36: fal-ḥaqqu yaʿlū walā yuʿlā ʿalayhi naʿam famunkiru l-ḥaqqi fī l-khusrāni wad-dīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v37: wash-shamsu ʾin ṭalaʿat yaghshā l-bilāda maʿā ḍiyāʾuhā watarāhā ʿaynu taʿyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v38: wal-ʿaynu ʾin ramidat tabdū kalālatuhā binaẓrati sh-shamsi lā tarnū ʾilā dūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v39: famu s-saqīmi ʾakhī ṭaʿmu l-furāti ʾajā ju fīhi mazkūmunā nāfī r-rayāḥīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v40: man kāna yajhalu shayʾā qad yuʿādīhi lil- jahli sh-shadīdi ʾidhā ẓannu l-majānīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v41: wakam tarā jāḥidā bil-ḥaqqi mujtahidā bayna l-ʾabāṭīli fī ʿādāti malʿūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v42: ʾamʿin biṭarfika yā naẓẓāru maʿ ʿajabi fī mahmahi l-ghayyī ʾighwāʾu sh-shayāṭīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v43: bushrā līʾākhidhi hadhā l-wirdi sālikihi man nālahu nāla ʾajrā ghayra mamnūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v44: law lā l-ʿināyatu kāna l-inkhirāṭa ʿalā wajhi s-suhūlati mimman kāna yuḥyīnī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v45: wakam ʾanāsi tamannā bis-sulūk ʿalā ʾuslūbihi mā qaḍā man qāla wat-tīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v46: man kāna yaslukuhu mawlāhu min karami ʾamātahu llāhu fī stiqrāʾi maʾadhūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v47: falā tarā ʾaḥadā min ʾahlihi ʾabadā ʾillā wasīmāhu fī ḥusni watazyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v48: fallāhu yaklaʾuhum ladā l-mawāṭini min qāfi ʾilā l-qāfi ʾaḥrā fī warā ṣ-ṣīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v49: lahum mina llāhi luṭfu qad yakhuṣṣu bihim ḍamānatu ṣ-ṣidqi khayru l-millahi d-dīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v50: wahum ʿaṣāʾibu dhikri fī ṭarīqatihim dawāʾiru l-khayri fī kulli l-ʾaḥāyīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v51: humu l-kirāmu waʾaṣḥābu r-rasūli waʾar bābu l-qubūli waʾahlu ḍ-ḍiʿfi wan-nūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v52: l-ḥamdu llāhi lammā khaṣṣanā karamā hadhī l-māʾāthira fī sirri wamakhzūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v53: famunyatī ṣāḥi fāqat fī ṭarīqatihi fahyā l-maniyyatu fīhā dhāka maʾamūnī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v54: taqabbala llāhu rabbu n-nāsi daʿwatanā mimmā nuḥḥibu bihi bijāhi yāsīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v56: ṣallā l-ʾilahu ʿalā l-maḥmūdi sayyidinā wal-ʾāli wiṣ-ṣaḥbi subbāqi l-mayādīni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v10: mālī ʾanīsu siwā sajʿi l-ḥamāʾimi fī llayli l-bahīmi wataṣghā s-samʿu maʿ hūni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-halmin-sabilin-c1-v55: ʾinna l-qaṣīdata hadhī min murīdi ʾabī l-fayḍi l-ʾilahi ʾabī bakri ʾakhī l-hūni
